observed: Explicit GITAUTH fetch can populate FETCH_HEAD while later porcelain/ref output is blank or unusable.
ODS-5 DCL literal .git uses [.^.GIT] and extensionless control files need a trailing period.
git reset --mixed --no-refresh FETCH_HEAD returned %X1035A00A and changed neither visible ref nor index.
git checkout -B ... FETCH_HEAD returned %X1035A00A and changed neither HEAD, branch ref, nor index.
git read-tree FETCH_HEAD succeeded and replaced the RMS-visible index.
git update-ref plus git symbolic-ref succeeded when verified through RMS-visible control files.
GIT_RESTORE then materialized changed candidate files reliably in short batches.

Restoring only a new candidate changed-file list can leave stale files from an earlier experimental branch, producing a hybrid tree; SRC/M251_SYNTH_TEST.C had to be restored from current HEAD before the canonical build passed.

m287_wc_campaign.goal: Use OVMS Agent itself on OpenVMS to create Unix-like wc in every installed language except C, accumulating agent/language gaps without stopping the campaign.
m287_wc_campaign.contract: lines/words/bytes; -l/-w/-c; canonical line/word/byte order for multiple options; one or more files with total for more than one; SYS$INPUT with no args where normal; ASCII/text only; POSIX logical bytes = RMS record data + LF per record; no GNU extras.

pascal.publication: pending exact accepted WC.PAS commit/push from native sandbox
validated_lessons: Compile/link success does not prove LIB$GET_FOREIGN calling semantics.
For this use case a local LIB$GET_FOREIGN declaration with %DESCR and a VARYING OF CHAR command buffer is native-compatible.
Supplying even an empty prompt argument makes bare LIB$GET_FOREIGN consume SYS$INPUT; omit the prompt argument when stdin must remain application data.
Derive command length from LENGTH(Command_Line) when only the resultant-string argument is used.

m287_wc_campaign.sandbox_policy: Use durable per-language vms-<language>-sandbox repositories. Language/compiler-specific defects belong in the language sandbox; generic OVMS Agent defects belong in ovms-agent. Campaign implementation content must be generated by OVMS Agent, not hand-authored externally.

standing_rules: Read RULES.MD on main and this state at chat start.
GitHub is the default repository editing control plane; OpenVMS is canonical compile/link/RMS/runtime acceptance authority.
Omit OVMS-AGENT> from agent command lines provided for paste.
Use GITAUTH for authenticated Git network operations; it already invokes Git.
Never trust Git status/porcelain/ref output or $STATUS alone on OpenVMS when RMS-visible files/control files can verify the fact directly.
Consult DOC/OPENVMS_GIT_QUIRKS.MD before inventing a new OpenVMS Git materialization workflow.
Canonical product acceptance requires All regression tests passed., Build completed successfully., and %X00000001 when source/build/runtime inputs changed.
Do not call an untested GitHub candidate or promoted merge native-green; distinguish exact-SHA acceptance from tree-equivalent promotion.
Keep root-level OVMS_AGENT.HLP synchronized with every user-visible command/persistent-setting/material behavior change in the same milestone.
Beginning with 1.0.0, semantic releases use vX.Y.Z tags in addition to mNNN milestone tags and follow semantic versioning.
Use uppercase DOC as the canonical documentation-history directory; root-level repository filenames are uppercase unless an external constraint requires otherwise.
DEC C/VAX-facing external identifiers remain <=31 characters and C89/DEC C compatible unless a subsystem specifically requires otherwise.

For the WC campaign, do not hand-author target-language implementations externally; make OVMS Agent generate them, capture gaps, and continue with DCL/native compiler bridge when the agent cannot execute the compiler itself.
